note_cross_ref: ckpt/stiefel_frame_s5_b1_mcmc.pt and ckpt/stiefel_frame600_b1_mcmc.pt hold byte-identical sample tensors, so 'floor_cross_mcmc_s5_vs_600' is a second split-half draw, not an independent reference chain.
note_basis: R-ASBS checkpoints store X in the R-ASBS basis (X_r = U X). All R-ASBS rows here are mapped back with U^T before any frame-sensitive statistic is taken; without that map E[tr(C^T X)] reads -0.3464 instead of 0.5274.
